changelog:
Version 1.4.0 introduces MCP Server security auditing to the code review checklist.

- Added "MCP Server 安全审计" section, covering risks and best practices for reviewing AI-facing REST APIs such as authentication, privilege separation, credential protection, destructive action confirmation, output boundaries, secure binding, and audit logging.
- Provided practical quick-check commands and a standardized MCP Server security grading table (A/B/C/F) to guide pre-deployment assessments.
- Reinforced integration of the new security axis with the existing multi-axial review (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance).
- Updated overview and review process documentation to incorporate MCP Server reviews as a standard part of skill and system audit workflows.
